notes: Mac and Linux support computers update themselves too, like Windows ones: from the main computer, checked against the published fingerprint, keeping the old copy in case the new one doesn't start.
A door station keeps check-ins while the main computer is asleep and sends them, with the time of each scan, when it's back.
Export the week to a spreadsheet: a sheet per zone, days across the top and the half hours down the side.
Undo any of the last ten schedule imports, not just the last one: Undo an import… lists them.
A profile shows the other names a schedule import knows the student by, and one that isn't them can be taken off.
Students named as tests ("test2", "Test 1") can be removed together from the Students tab, after you untick any that are real.
Adding a student who looks already on the roster asks first, by hand and in the student import: a middle name, a nickname or a slip in the spelling is noticed.
how: Shahien will send you the new installer. Install it over the old one; your records stay as they are.
